<noscript>
  <h1>Büchi–expression equivalence</h1>
  <p>An expression term builds a Büchi automaton that completes infinitely many blocks. Conversely, an accepting run revisits one final state infinitely often and can be cut into a prefix leading to that state followed by infinitely many non-empty return loops.</p>
</noscript>
